name: Neftis
source:
"So you're Kiichi, right? I'm Neftis. You can call me Nef."

Another agent who says she's Isis's sister. Like Isis, her true identity is shrouded in mystery. A bratty bitch who loves to provoke Kiichi.

She loves mahjong and karaage.

[Translated from the [url=http://www.astronauts.co.jp/sirius/emtneo/chara.html?page=chara9]official website[/url]]
